entries.problem: A hosted MCP surface needs explicit resource and authentication bounds rather than inheriting stdio assumptions.
entries.resolution: Require bounded body/response/depth/time/concurrency/rate controls and bearer authentication before any non-loopback bind.

entries.problem: A useful operator demo needs inspectable evidence without implying that a command was executed.
entries.resolution: Emit deterministic ALLOW/BLOCK/REFUSED JSON receipts with executed:false and explicit local-simulation limitations.
